title: Thailand's National Adaptation Plan (NAP)
organization: Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Thailand
temporal_coverage: National adaptation plan; provincial climate-risk rankings modelled for 2016–2035 under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5.
methodology: National plan reproduces ONEP consultant models and sectoral risk assessments for climate adaptation planning.
limitations: Provincial top-ten lists are model outputs attributed to ONEP 2021, not measured current impacts; the settlements-and-security sector label is not a conflict indicator.

title: Thailand Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Published 2025; includes historical/current diagnostics, projections and a Khon Kaen provincial water-management case.
methodology: World Bank country assessment with biophysical modeling and policy analysis; Industrial Economics supported physical-risk modeling.
limitations: Model scenarios and dates are stated claim-by-claim; the Khon Kaen institutional case describes planning processes, not evaluated climate-resilience outcomes.

title: Climate Change Adaptation Implementation and Governance in Thailand: Increased Resilience and Potential Conflicts
organization: Springer Nature, in Risks, Resilience and Interdependency
temporal_coverage: Open-access chapter published 2025; reviews climate-adaptation governance and source-reported conflict examples, including a 2004 drought case.
methodology: Qualitative text analysis of policies, government data, public records and climate/conflict literature.
limitations: Document review, not primary causal research; authors say Thailand linkages remain understudied.

title: Gender Equality and Social Inclusion Analysis (Thailand, 2025)
temporal_coverage: 2025 gender and social inclusion study prepared for the CINTALAM youth-led climate-action project.
methodology: Publisher abstract describes the study as mixed-methods; extracted findings are limited to that official abstract.
limitations: Full report PDF was not retrievable; sample, detailed methods and locality-level results were not inspected, and the abstract does not establish causal effects.

title: Women leading peace and climate resilience in southern Thailand
organization: United Nations in Thailand / UN Women
temporal_coverage: UN story published 2 April 2026; includes participant accounts and captions on the Yupo flood of 25 November 2025.
methodology: Qualitative UN country feature profiles women and community organizations, with named-site observations, participant accounts and captions.
limitations: A feature story, not representative monitoring or climate-attribution research; local event estimates and reported experiences are not population-level measures.
